description: Primary webpage and PDF retrieval tool. Use by default to fetch any public HTTP/HTTPS webpage or PDF and return clean text, Markdown, links, and metadata. Uses fast HTTP first and automatically falls back to an isolated headless browser for JavaScript-rendered pages. (Use webpage_to_markdown or extract_webpage_text for token-saving single-format output, or render_webpage when you need raw rendered HTML DOM.)

force_browser.description: Start with browser rendering instead of fast HTTP retrieval.
force_browser.title: Force Browser

max_chars.description: Maximum characters returned for content and Markdown.
max_chars.title: Max Chars

url.description: Public HTTP or HTTPS URL of a webpage or PDF to retrieve.
url.title: Url

name: fetch_webpage
